# Performance budgets

163 budgets. Limits are hard; targets are goals. `machine = any` rows are machine-independent. CI hosted runners gate only relative regressions (see `docs/perf/benchmarks.md`). How the UI thread stays within these: [threading.md](threading.md).

## Machines

| class | description | cpu | RAM | gpu | display |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ref_laptop_2024` | Reference laptop: 8 performance cores / 16 threads, Windows 11 and a current Wayland desktop | x86_64-v3, 8C/16T | 16 GB | integrated, 2024 mid-range | 2560x1600 at 120 Hz |
| `ci_linux_x64` | GitHub ubuntu-24.04 hosted runner (public repository) | 4 vCPU x86_64 | 16 GB | none (lavapipe) | headless |
| `ci_windows_x64` | GitHub windows-2025 hosted runner (public repository) | 4 vCPU x86_64 | 16 GB | none (WARP) | headless |
| `any` | Machine-independent (counts, allocations, wakeups) | any | 0 GB | any | any |
